fields.climate: tropical in south, desert in north
fields.terrain: broad, arid plains in center, desert in north, mountains in northwest, lowlands in south
fields.hazards: hot, dry, dusty harmattan winds occur in north; periodic droughts; locust plagues
fields.resources: petroleum, uranium, natron, kaolin, fish (Lake Chad), gold, limestone, sand and gravel, salt
fields.farm: sorghum, groundnuts, millet, beef, cereals, yams, sugarcane, maize, cassava, milk
fields.exports: crude petroleum, gold, oil seeds, gum resins, cotton
fields.industries: oil, cotton textiles, brewing, natron (sodium carbonate), soap, cigarettes, construction materials
fields.languages: French (official), Arabic (official), Sara (in south), more than 120 languages and dialects
fields.religions: Muslim 52.1%, Protestant 23.9%, Roman Catholic 20%, animist 0.3%, other Christian 0.2%, none 2.8%, unspecified 0.7% (2014-15 est.)
fields.legal: mixed system of civil and customary law
fields.military: 18-25 for voluntary service; men subject to 18-36 months of compulsory service at age 20; women are subject to 12 months of compulsory military or civic service at age 21
